Files written by ControlFreak before the container code moved into this package
(format version 1, no `exchange`). Every later version must still read them; never
rewrite them, add new files next to them instead. The data is made up.

- `fixtur-v1.cfproj` – project file.
- `fixtur-v1.cfpack` – pack with a gzip-compressed map.
- `fixtur-v1.map.ocd` – the map inside the pack, for a byte-by-byte comparison.
